Note:

S contains only lowercase letters.
1 <= S.length <= 2000
</problem>

```
int rec(int sz, int idx, string S) {
    if (idx == (int)S.size()) return sz == 0 ? 1 : 0;
    int ret = rec(sz-1, idx+1, S) % MOD;
    for (int i = idx+1; i <= sz; ++i) 
        ret += rec(sz-i, idx+i, S);
    return ret % MOD;
}
int distinctSubseqII(string S) {
    return rec(S.size(), 0, S);
}
```
